Sikkim Police state no terror module after youth's arrest

Sikkim Police have stated there is no terror module in the state following the arrest of a youth linked to the Islamic State. The arrest was made after intelligence agencies flagged suspicious online activity. An MLA had previously called for tenant and shop verification.
